Baldwin 5510-TSTR, Estates Collection T Strike Plate

This standard T Strike is for use with Baldwin's Estates Collection privacy and passage latches. It is available in a wide array of finishes. The Baldwin Standard Box Strike comes packaged with the installation screws.

Features and Specifications of the Baldwin Estates T Srike Plate:

  • Length: 2.75"
  • Width: 1.575"
  • Lip Width: .75"
  • Lip Length: 1.5"
  • Thickness: .062"
  • Lip to Center Dimension: 1.312"

Sold Individually
